title: FakeSpotter：内容与策略无关的病毒式虚假信息检测工具
summary: FakeSpotter 通过测量虚假信息的结构性指纹（语言、叙事、逻辑与批判性思维维度），而非直接判断真伪，来评估文本的病毒式虚假信息风险。它结合重复的 LLM 评估与逻辑回归分类器，在 764 篇文本上短文本宏 F1 达 0.788，长文本达 0.793，并提供可解释输出。
summary_en: FakeSpotter estimates the viral misinformation risk of text by measuring structural fingerprints of misinformation rather than adjudicating truthfulness. It combines repeated LLM assessments with domain-specific logistic regression classifiers across linguistic, narrative, logical, and critical-thinking dimensions, achieving macro F1 of 0.788 for short texts and 0.793 for long texts on a labelled corpus of 764 texts, with explainable outputs.
